outline: This course aims at instructing students to know and familiar with the various applications of computer in civil engineering fields. It includes computer aid calculations and the usage of softwares.
schedule:
1st week	Orientation
2nd week	Peace Memorial Day
3rd week	Introduction
4th week	Shear & Moment Diagrams
5th week	RC Single Reinforced Beams
6th week	RC Doubly Reinforced Beams
7th week	Spring Break
8th week	RC Columns – P-M Diagrams
9th week	Midterm exam.
10th week Matrix Algebra
11th week Matrix Computation
12th week	Introduction to FEM
13th week	Element Stiffness Matrices
14th week	Software ETABS
15th week	Application of ETABS
16th week	Dragon Boat Festival
17th week	Final Report
18th week	Final Report
